claim_1.claim: microarray analysis of peripheral blood cells from 92 healthy male adults at baseline (day 0) and days 1, 3, and 14 after influenza vaccination (day 0), using Gene Ontology, DAVID, and Ingenuity pathway analyses, showed that the maximum gene expression change occurred on day 1 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: The maximum expression change occurred on day 1, while day 14 had the greatest number of genes with maximum expression values.

claim_2.claim: microarray analysis of peripheral blood cells from 92 healthy male adults at baseline (day 0) and days 1, 3, and 14 after influenza vaccination (day 0), using Gene Ontology, DAVID, and Ingenuity pathway analyses, showed early upregulation of interferon response, antiviral defense, cellular activation and differentiation, and antigen processing and presentation genes on day 1 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: As expected, the early phase of transcriptional activation was marked by upregulation of genes involved in multiple immune processes.

Overall, there were significantly increased transcript levels for genes participating in antiviral defense response (eg, GO:0009615), cellular activation (eg, GO:0001775), and cellular differentiation (eg, GO:0045582). Activation of antigen processing and presentation is implied by the increased expression of major histocompatibility complex (MHC) Class I genes (eg, GO:002474). Associations were most significant for the interferon response pathway (GO:0005062, GO:0034341, and GO:0034340) when compared with other cytokines.

claim_3.claim: microarray analysis of peripheral blood cells from 92 healthy male adults at baseline (day 0) and days 1, 3, and 14 after influenza vaccination (day 0), using Gene Ontology, DAVID, and Ingenuity pathway analyses, showed late upregulation of genes involved in macromolecule biosynthesis, cellular protein metabolism, RNA metabolic processing, and antiapoptosis on day 14 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: In contrast, the late vaccine response was characterized by increased detection of transcripts for genes involved in intracellular processes suggestive of active cellular proliferation, including macromolecule biosynthesis (eg, GO:0009059), cellular protein metabolism (eg, GO:0044267), RNA metabolic processing (eg, GO:0016070), and regulation of antiapoptosis (GO:0045767).

claim_4.claim: microarray analysis of peripheral blood cells from 92 healthy male adults at baseline (day 0) and days 1, 3, and 14 after influenza vaccination (day 0) showed that the abundance of 494 transcripts significantly correlated with the titer response index, compared to transcripts that did not correlate with antibody response.

sources.quote: We found that the abundance level of 494 transcripts significantly correlated with the TRI (Dataset 8).

claim_5.claim: microarray analysis of peripheral blood cells from 92 healthy male adults at baseline (day 0) and days 1, 3, and 14 after influenza vaccination (day 0) showed that STAT1 expression increased after vaccination, most prominently on day 1, in high responders compared to low and intermediate responders and compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: STAT1 expression increases after vaccination, most prominently on day 1 and in the high-responder group.

claim_6.claim: microarray analysis of peripheral blood cells from 92 healthy male adults at baseline (day 0) and days 1, 3, and 14 after influenza vaccination (day 0) showed that E2F2 expression was downregulated after vaccination, most prominently on day 3, with greater downregulation in high responders compared to low and intermediate responders and compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: E2F2 expression is downregulated after vaccination, most prominently on day 3 and with greater downregulation in the high-responder group.

claim_7.claim: microarray analysis of peripheral blood cells from the 10 highest and 10 lowest titer responders at days 1 and 3 after influenza vaccination (day 0) showed that the difference between STAT1 and E2F2 expression differentiated individuals at the two extremes of the response spectrum compared to each other.

sources.quote: Remarkably, the difference between STAT1 and E2F2 expression alone generates a gradient that corresponds clearly to the TRI at the two extremes of the response spectrum (Figure 2C, top).

claim_8.claim: microarray analysis of peripheral blood cells from the highest and lowest antibody responders at days 1 and 3 after influenza vaccination (day 0), using cross-validated linear prediction with the subset of genes in Table 1, showed that residual expression values predicted the observed titer response index compared to the opposite responder group.

sources.quote: We show that the residual expression values on days 1 and 3 are predictive of the observed TRI for each individual and, more importantly, that the cross-validated predicted TRI recategorized the highest and lowest responders into the appropriate groups (Figure 2D).

claim_9.claim: microarray analysis of peripheral blood cells from high responders compared to low responders after influenza vaccination (day 0), using content analysis, showed enrichment of interferon response and antigen presentation pathways in the high-responder group compared to the low-responder group.

sources.quote: Content analysis of the genes that were upregulated in the high-responder group showed enrichment of GO categories involved in cellular immune responses, most notably the interferon response and antigen presentation pathways (Figure 3A and Datasets 9, 10).

claim_10.claim: microarray analysis of peripheral blood cells from high responders compared to low responders after influenza vaccination (day 0) showed that interferon pathway genes were more highly upregulated in high responders than in low responders.

sources.quote: Genes within the interferon response pathway were highly upregulated in the high-responder group (Figure 3B).

claim_11.claim: hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) tests analysis of serum from 92 healthy male adults before vaccination and on days 14 and 28 after influenza vaccination (day 0) showed that HAI titers were strongly correlated with neutralization titers compared to the other antibody assay.

sources.quote: Antibody titers were measured by both hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) and neutralization assays. The titer results from these assays were strongly correlated, and the titers generally plateaued after day 14.

claim_12.claim: hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) tests analysis of serum from 92 healthy male adults before vaccination and on days 14 and 28 after influenza vaccination (day 0) showed that HAI titers generally plateaued after day 14 compared to the earlier post-vaccination rise.

sources.quote: Antibody titers were measured by both hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) and neutralization assays. The titer results from these assays were strongly correlated, and the titers generally plateaued after day 14.

claim_13.claim: hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) tests analysis of serum from 92 healthy male adults showed that the rise in HAI titer had a significant positive relationship with the titer response index compared to lower TRI values.

sources.quote: The TRI and rise in HAI titer for the 92 individuals show a significant positive relationship (r2 5 0.4585).

claim_14.claim: neutralizing antibody tests analysis of serum from 92 healthy male adults before vaccination and on days 14 and 28 after influenza vaccination (day 0) showed that neutralization titers were strongly correlated with HAI titers compared to the other antibody assay.
